target: One final independent adversarial L2 audit of the exact frozen S0 whole-system architecture subject; no implementation or ratification
invariants: Current runtime/source/config/tests and live Git/GitHub state outrank uploaded snapshots, historical handoffs, plans, and architecture prose
Use OBSERVED, INFERRED, PROPOSED, CLAIMED, CONFLICTING, UNKNOWN, and NOT_RUN; every UNKNOWN names missing evidence

Preserve system boundaries: Dopemux coordinates; DCP controls policy/context; Dopetask executes only separately authorized work; Task Orchestrator owns workflow legality; canonical systems retain domain authority
No merge, mark-ready, activation, credential/permission change, production mutation, destructive action, history rewrite, or automatic execution authority is granted
No secrets, tokens, cookies, private keys, raw credentials, or sensitive provider payloads may enter research/proof artifacts
Ordinary main movement triggers affected-fact reharvest rather than blanket restart; exact SHA equality is required only where subject provenance requires it
A0 is judgment, not implementation; repository/runtime/GitHub mutation beyond its own audit/proof artifact publication is forbidden
Preferred audit route is a live-proven independent AGY/Gemini Pro-class route; operator candidate gemini-3.1-pro-high is reverified at dispatch and not silently substituted
Codex/OpenAI family must not serve as final auditor if S0 was authored by an OpenAI-family model
One bounded substantive repair may be authorized only after FAIL; no automatic second/third audit loop

pr.title: docs(wsac): final independent whole-system architecture audit
pr.body: Whole-system architecture convergence evidence. No merge, activation, production, credential, or runtime mutation authority.

steps.task: Verify exact S0 subject hashes, repo identity, auditor identity/independence, and current material drift before judgment.
validation: A0 audits the exact frozen S0 bytes; hash mismatch or materially stale subject blocks judgment
Auditor is independent of the S0 architecture author and uses a different family/runtime where available
Requested/configured/served/proxy/provider-attested model identity stages are recorded separately; UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN

steps.task: Adversarially challenge authority boundaries and system/dataflow design.
validation: Attempt to prove duplicate writers, hidden authority transfer, DCP/UAG/router overreach, bridge/retrieval laundering, runner-private-state promotion, Wiki/context authority creep, or workflow/execution bypass
Attempt to prove missing degraded-state, retry/idempotency, purge/invalidation, identity, custody, multi-project, or stale-evidence handling
Every challenge ends PASS, RISK, FAIL, or UNKNOWN with concrete evidence

steps.task: Adversarially challenge runner/MCP/agent integration and future adaptability.
validation: Attempt to prove the common capability/agent abstraction loses semantics for at least one current runner
Attempt to prove generated minimal tool surfaces cannot preserve required authority/tool capabilities
Attempt to prove exact-model independence, version adaptation, conformance testing, or fallback provenance is underspecified

steps.task: Adversarially challenge convergence DAG and falsification plan.
validation: Attempt to find hidden dependency cycles, unsafe parallelism, shared-writer collisions, migration dead ends, activation ambiguity, or benchmark metrics that can be gamed
No architecture recommendation is accepted merely because it is elegant or already planned

steps.task: Issue one final exact-subject verdict and stop.
validation: Verdict is PASS, PASS_WITH_RISKS, FAIL, NEEDS_SUPERVISOR, or SKIPPED
PASS_WITH_RISKS lists every non-blocking risk explicitly
FAIL/NEEDS_SUPERVISOR/SKIPPED/head mismatch/unknown auditor identity blocks ratification eligibility
A0 does not modify S0 architecture bytes or implement repairs
